title.narrative: African Activist for Climate Justice (AACJ) Project in Kenya

description.narrative: Natural Justice (NJ) is a consortium member of the Power of Voices Partnerships' (PVP) African Activists for Climate Justice (AACJ) project. In Kenya, the project seeks to build and strengthen inclusive movements and push for human-rights based approach to climate justice. NJ targets Indigenous People and Local communities in marginalized and climate change vulnerable counties of Kenya. It seeks to create a platform where a diverse network of actors can proactively engage in decision-making, policy influencing and developing climate narratives for the realization of broad-based change. NJ works with four (4) local partners, with aligned vision, to implement its activities. These partners include: Kaputir Resource Management Organization (KARMO) in Turkana County, Malindi Rights Forum (MRF) in Kilifi County, Community Land Action Now (CLAN!); a movement supporting member Indigenous communities to champion for their rights, and Lamu Women Alliance (LAWA) in Lamu county.
